results.title: Bookella — Book Tracker & Home Library App
results.content:
## What can you do with Bookella?

### All your books in one place

Paper books, e-books and audiobooks, read and unread. Your library is right there, cover by cover.

### See how far you’ve read

Every book shows your progress and how long it’ll take to finish at your pace.

### Time your reading

Start the timer when you open a book and watch your daily goal fill up. No timer? Just log the page you stopped on.

## Why Bookella?

### Goals that keep you reading

Set a goal for the year and one for each day. A little reading every day adds up fast.

### Add books in seconds

Pick from reading lists, scan a barcode, or bring your library over from Goodreads, StoryGraph and other apps.

### Books in your language [...] - ### Reading timer
  
  Time your sessions, set a countdown, and get a reminder on the days you choose.
- ### Goals & stats
  
  A calendar that marks every reading day, plus detailed stats with Premium.
- ### Add books your way
  
  Search by title or author, pick from reading lists, scan a barcode or add a book by hand.
- ### E-books & audiobooks
  
  Progress in pages, percent or minutes, so every format counts.
- ### Notes & quotes
  
  Save thoughts and quotes with the page number. Share any of them as a card.
- ### Collections & places
  
  Group books into collections and note the shelf or room where each one lives.
- ### Loans
  
  Keep track of books you lend and borrow, with a reminder when one is due back.
- ### Import & export [...] ### What if a book is not in the catalog?

Add it by hand, with your own photo of the cover. It behaves like any other book in your library — on shelves, in collections, in your reading stats.

### Does it work for e-books and audiobooks?

Yes. Mark the format, and progress is counted the way you read it: pages for paper, percent for e-books, minutes for audiobooks. A library book or an audiobook can count as read without being on your shelves.

### What happens if I change phones?

Sign in to your account on the new phone and your library, reading history and notes come back. Everything is saved to your account, not only to the device.

results.content: Your home library and reading log in one app. Scan a barcode to add a book, see instantly if it is already on your shelf, and track every page you read. Bookella is a book tracker for people who own books and read them. Keep your home library and your reading log in one place: what you have, where it stands, who borrowed it, and what you are reading right now. SCAN YOUR BOOKSHELF Point the camera at a barcode and the book is in your library in a second. The scanner works offline and tells you right in the viewfinder if the book is already at home or if you have read it before, so you never buy a second copy by accident. TRACK YOUR READING Mark books as Want to read, Reading, Read or Abandoned. Keep an Up next queue separate from your endless wishlist. Log a session with a timer or just [...] your endless wishlist. Log a session with a timer or just type the page you stopped at. Paper, ebook and audiobook progress are counted the way each format works. READING GOALS AND STATS Set a yearly book goal or a daily reading time goal and watch your reading calendar fill up. See how much you read, when you read best, and which authors, genres and languages you return to. NOTES, QUOTES AND RATINGS Save quotes and thoughts as you read, rate books with half stars and describe how a book felt with simple scales. A LIBRARY THAT KNOWS WHAT YOU OWN Shelves are collections and places: the living room, the kids' room, the summer house. Record the format, condition and number of copies. Lend a book with a due date and get a reminder when it should come back. BOOKS IN YOUR LANGUAGE The catalog [...] it should come back. BOOKS IN YOUR LANGUAGE The catalog searches national libraries and stores in many countries, so you find the edition you actually hold — with the title in its own language and the right volume of a series. BRING YOUR LIBRARY WITH YOU Import your books from Goodreads, StoryGraph or any CSV file with a preview before anything is saved. Export your library to CSV or PDF with covers at any time. Sign in to keep everything in sync between iPhone and iPad. FREE AND PREMIUM Reading sessions, scanning, notes, import and goals are free forever, and there are no ads. The free version has a limit on the number of books and collections. Premium removes the limits and adds detailed reading statistics, photos in notes and export. Terms of Use:  Privacy Policy:

results.title: Bookly - Book Tracker and Reading Tracker
results.content:
Bookly is the perfect app for tracking your reading progress, reaching your goals, and maintaining an organized catalog of all your read books! It can help you with personalized stats during reading sessions in real-time, keeping you motivated and helping improve your reading habits.

Bookly has tons of cool features fit for everyone, from novice bookworms to diligent academics, helping you set a reading routine that helps you crush all your reading goals. Here’s how Bookly gets you into the habit of reading more:

## Track Your Reading Time:

Just start the timer when you want to read – Bookly will take care of the rest. Not only will you track your reading speed, but you’ll also know exactly how long a book will take to finish. [...] And the best part is that you’ll get a personalized report with your reading stats, so you can see how you’re improving in real-time.

## Keep Your Reading Focus:

Forget about reading slumps or mid-year freakout tags! 

By having a clear idea of real-time progress, you can improve your reading skills and further build your reading habit. 

Each time you manage to complete a reading goal, you’ll be able to unlock badges, achievements, and other goodies in the app.

## More than a Book Tracker:

Bookly is the little book tracking app with a lot to do: it can organize your bookshelf, take notes, create reports, and help you save quotes, all while reaching your goals and participating in our regular reading challenges – the Bookly Readathons!
